content_about_page_description: Board Together is a free, open source place to play board games online with friends. Join the conversation or help build the next game.
content_about_lead: {#wordmark/} is a place to play board games online with friends.
content_about_welcome: We hope you’ve been enjoying your games here. If you have feedback, we’d love to hear it.
content_about_talk_body: Have a question, an idea, or a game that isn’t behaving? Come chat with us on Discord. Compliments and complaints are welcome, too.
content_about_contribute_body: Want to contribute? Take a look at the Tabletop project on GitHub. There are plenty of ways to help, with or without writing code.
content_about_pay_it_forward_body: We don’t want personal donations. If playing here has been worth something to you, help bring games to people who need them.
content_pif_gamers_outreach_description: Builds medical-grade gaming carts and brings them to kids in hospitals who can’t leave their rooms. Over 350 hospitals so far.
content_pif_special_effect_description: Occupational therapists and gaming specialists set up adapted controllers and eye control, so people with physical disabilities can play the games they love.
content_pif_page_description: BoardTogether is free and doesn't want personal donations. If you've enjoyed playing, help bring games to people who need them through Gamers Outreach or SpecialEffect.
content_pif_lead: {#wordmark/} is free, and we plan to keep it that way.
content_pif_bills_are_ours: The bills are ours, and nothing you give from this page comes to us.
content_pif_pass_it_on_body: If the games here have been worth something to you, help put games in front of people who need them. Board game charities are few and mostly small, so we’ve looked to our big brother, video games.
content_pif_pass_it_on_wide: These two well-established charities bring games to people who can’t easily get to them: kids stuck in hospital rooms, and players who need adapted controls.
content_pif_opens_campaign: Opens the BoardTogether campaign on tiltify.com.
content_pif_other_charities: If these two aren’t for you, give to your favorite charity instead. It’s paying it forward all the same.
content_pif_receives_nothing: BoardTogether receives nothing from these links.
